crossRefs.note: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in…

translations.web: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
translations.bsb: Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?
translations.kjv: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
translations.asv: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;
